title: Shopify Catalog & Price / Stock Watchlist
description: Export authorized storefront catalogs or track repeat price/availability observations for US merchants and ecommerce agencies. The prefilled demo is a labeled bundled fixture, not live market data.

storeUrls.title: Shopify Store URLs / Domains
storeUrls.description: Store domains, clean collection URLs (/collections/handle), or product URLs (/products/handle). Unsupported paths, queries and fragments are rejected, not silently expanded to the whole store. The default is an explicitly labeled bundled Mock.Shop demo, not a live scrape.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max Products Per Store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum number of products to scrape per store. The default is 1 for a low-cost first run.

productType.title: Filter by Product Type
productType.description: Only keep products whose product type matches this exactly (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.

trackChanges.title: Track prices, stock and variant changes
trackChanges.description: Compare successfully saved live products with private history under the same watchlist. Includes JSON, changes CSV and a readable report without additional source requests or alert events. Every saved live product is still charged, including unchanged ones. Demo rows do not advance history.

watchlistName.title: Watchlist name for repeat runs
watchlistName.description: Reuse the same name and scope for comparisons. Use different names for different clients. Do not overlap runs of the same watchlist. Scope, filter, product limit and declared currency changes create a separate baseline.

maxHistoryPoints.title: Recent observations retained per product
maxHistoryPoints.description: Keep 2–30 saved price/availability observations per product (default 10). First-observed time and total count remain available. Bounded history is not an unlimited archive.

storeCurrency.title: Declared currency (optional, e.g. USD)
storeCurrency.description: Only declare a three-letter code if you know all selected feeds use it. This is user-provided, not independently verified. Leave empty to keep currency unknown; raw value changes remain visible but currency-dependent deltas/percent alerts are withheld. US audience does not imply USD. Use separate runs for different currencies.

confirmAuthorizedUse.title: I am authorized to monitor these stores
confirmAuthorizedUse.description: Required for any real store. Confirm that you own, administer, or have permission to monitor each supplied storefront. Not required for the official demo.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave proxy off for the official demo and normal public storefront access. A proxy does not override store permissions, robots.txt, or access restrictions.
